counters: Bait repeated use of one side; punish windup/recovery.

equipment: The Cadet suit is ordinary equipment. It never assigns this quirk or grants a move. New support equipment is distinguished from the actual power.
acquisition: Experimental development kit. Permission-checked creative assignment restores earned mastery. Field objectives and meaningful per-quirk mission practice unlock techniques; general rewards are single-claim. Server-enabled starting/reroll pools are authoritative.
verification: Original user, Japanese label and the stated basic principle checked on the official profile on 28 October 2026. English labels are working labels; no unverified first-appearance claim is made.
